headline: Withings now charges $100/year for Apple Health sync for new users
summary: New Withings users must pay $99/year for the Withings+ subscription to automatically sync data with Apple Health or other third-party apps, effective October 13. Existing users are not affected.
details: Withings is now gating third-party app syncing, including Apple Health, behind its $100/year Withings+ subscription for new users. This policy applies to accounts created after October 13.
Existing users are unaffected by this change. New free users will need to manually export and upload their data to other platforms, rather than enjoying automatic synchronization.

The company confirmed the change on its support forum, stating that automatic sync to third-party apps is now part of Withings+. Many existing users are criticizing the new charge for a basic feature.
Withings is known for high-end smart health devices, such as the $600 Body Scan 2 scale. This new subscription requirement adds to the cost of using their ecosystem.
